title: Common tensor model for normalized internal scalar pullback
statement: Let a:Λ→Λ′ be a morphism of commutative condensed rings and f:X→Y a scheme morphism. Use D,V,L,B₀,B and their specified computation counits from [def-sfb-internal-derived-scalar-comparisons] and the exact restriction/pullback comparison [def-sfb-derived-comap-upper-star-iso]. Let b:V_Y L_R→L_S V_X be that exact comparison conjugated by the exact-left-derived identifications. Let v_T:V_T(1_S)≅B_T be restriction of the regular single complex followed by the fixed localization/single comparisons. Put c=L_R(v_Y inverse), then b at 1_S, then V_X of the geometric unit comparison, then v_X. For P in the homotopy category define T_P from L_R(Qh P) tensor B_X by tensoring c inverse and then the target comparison of [new-integral-residue-tensor-model], using F=ordinary pullback, G=L_R and its exact counit. Define C_P by tensorModelMapWith for the same F,G,counit, B₀,Y, H=D_Y V_Y and the canonical restricted scalar tensorPresentationDerivedCounit. All maps are concrete composites; neither flatness of a nor a choice from an existence theorem is used.
